scope.reviewMethod: direct Japanese semantic comparison of all translated fields

reviewProgress.notes: Read every JA/TL/TH field; crop family, cucumber parthenocarpy, strawberry runner order, short-day lighting delay and lily bulb cooling preserved.
Compared complete flower forms and house types fields. Corrected TL herbaceous perennial terminology; roof-only shelter scope and no pest guarantee preserved.
Read all fields directly: roof geometry, PVC toxic-gas warning, PO comparison, inclusive ten-year statement and differing source replacement ranges preserved.
Read all inner-cover, heating and cover-function fields; UV/honeybee qualification and EVA hot-folded storage preserved. Corrected general fuel terminology and classified exact level-2 digit case.
Direct reading of ventilation sequence/conditional switches, daylight CO2 qualification, current versus reset-bound max/min and liquid meniscus reading; no corrections.
All fields read: winter humidity/condensation, seedling observations without diagnosis, true leaves excluding cotyledons, hydroponic media and recirculation distinction preserved.

Read nursery containers, graft resistance versus harvest quality roles, and every pF field. Preserved higher-drier direction, 15% soil-specific examples, 1.8–2.7 source2 scope and inclusive 3.0/4.0 persistence boundaries.

All fields read for circulation, fruit lifespan and buds: comparative disease risk, untreated discharge not authorized, 20–40-year qualified period, old/new fruiting branches and no nutrient/water cutoff retained.
Read all propagation, graft-type and alignment fields. Rootstock/scion and attached-until-rooting sequence preserved; corrected Thai and/or relation in wax/bag depiction.

Read pruning intensity, heading versus thinning, leaf-bud cut position, tree-form qualifications and pollination/fertilization/parthenocarpy distinctions; sequence and most-fruit maturity scope preserved.

Read full source2 definition, bud-pattern and bagging sets. At least 2 years, historical 2021 volume/value distinction, three branch-year patterns, and crop-specific wire/fruit positioning retained; clarified TL herbaceous wording.
Read harvest maturity versus after-ripening examples, late-June–late-August window and mandarin two-cut order; renewal branch retention and orchard water/air/drainage conditions preserved.
Directly read all fertilizer roles/months/application sites, citrus preconditioning and CA oxygen/CO2 directions, alternate bearing/dwarfing and gibberellin condition limits; no additional patches.

All crop-specific persimmon/pear/peach, machines and grape-cluster fields read. Preserved 3 and 7/8 year qualified examples, no operational capacity inference and before-flowering/after-set sequence; corrected pruning-saw referent.

Read maturity instruments/sample limits, annual/biennial/perennial classifications and bulb/corm/tuber/rhizome/root distinctions. Clarified TL woody flowering plant wording in two fields; no invented shared thresholds.

All production ranges/cost comparisons, handling quality symptoms and water/cooling/grading/packaging, cold-chain and preservative-purpose fields read. Corrected woody category, TL quality collocation, and Thai shipment/export scope.

Read all bedding seasonal scopes, ground-cover purposes and soil/seed terms. Japanese readings せいち/しろかき/ちゅうこう and しゅしよそ/せんしゅ/しんしゅ/さいが preserved; preparation versus individual completion and before-sowing scope preserved.

Read all cropping/fruit/weather/photo label fields directly. Earlier/later normal-crop comparison, treatment objectives, summer cold-damage and actual-damage conditions, and distinct JA readings retained.
